cards.review_notes: The camp page is undated and states up-and-coming kindergarten through eighth grade. Confirm that eligibility remains current. It lists $100/week for members, $140/week for non-members and a $10 same-week sibling discount, but no season year is stated, so prices were omitted rather than assigned to 2026 or 2027. Confirm dates, hours, registration and drop-off location directly with the provider. YMCA of the USA lists the facility at 404 Y St, Greeneville, TN, but the available camp text does not identify it as the camp drop-off site.
